author: Good Enough
description:
The U.S. government released official UFO videos showing mysterious unidentified objects flying off the coasts of San Diego and Florida, and they remain some of the most discussed UAP encounters ever recorded. This Short explores what military pilots captured on camera, why these objects attracted so much attention, and why the footage is still debated today.

Learn what happened during these famous UAP encounters, what made the objects so unusual, and why the released footage continues to fascinate pilots, investigators, and UFO enthusiasts around the world.
title: The Government Released This UFO 🛸😲 #ufo #unexplained #shorts
